# access-review-report

> Build periodic access review reports from system account exports and an HR roster: terminated users with access, orphaned, dormant and never-used accounts, and privileged roles. Python package `trysac-access-review-report`, import name `access_review_report`, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
